defects_found.description: boss_ruling.rulings contains a synthetic key "RV-INSUFFICIENT-M8-Exod-136" that does not correspond to any challenge_id in any primary_reviews[].challenges array (the rev_ol_opus_x05_r1 reviewer returned verdict=insufficient_evidence with an empty challenges list, i.e. no formal challenge was ever filed). This is the only orphan ruling key in the book (mechanically verified across all 158 packets: 0 orphan author-responses, 1 orphan ruling). It does not violate the letter of the response-parity check (every actual filed challenge in this packet -- OL-M8-Exod-136-1 and OL-M8-Exod-136-2 -- has exactly one author response and one boss ruling), but it is an inconsistent convention: M8-Exod-074 has the structurally identical situation (a primary review with verdict=insufficient_evidence and no filed challenge) and there the boss simply left rulings empty with top-level reasoning "Unchallenged; primary support stands." Non-blocking; does not affect the frozen decision content, which is sound and appropriately kept at medium_low with three live readings recorded.

The "(single-witness)" disclosure tag on oshb:/wlc citations is applied inconsistently to plain Hebrew-text quotations across primary_reviews[].evidence_refs: 383/661 (58%) of oshb/wlc citations in that field carry the tag, dropping further in revision-round citations (rev_ol_opus_x0N_r1 attempts: 47 tagged vs 117 untagged) and in micro-round citations (0/3 for lf, 3/13 for ol). IMPORTANT: this does NOT violate the OWNER_ADDENDUM binding rule ("single_witness_marker_claim_requires_variance_disclosure"), which is scoped specifically to scribal-marker claims (petuchah/setumah/parashah) -- I mechanically verified 100% (0 misses) of petuchah/setumah/parashah citations across the whole book DO carry the tag correctly. The gap is only on plain consonantal-text quotations, which decision 001 (the first-drafted packet) tags but many later reviewer attempts do not; a stylistic/documentation inconsistency, not a rule violation. Chunk-level boundary_evidence_refs (the frozen/authoritative field) is even looser (2/100 oshb refs tagged), consistent with that field using a terser citation style throughout the book, not a regression.
